preceding_dynamic_light_failure.resolution: Protect surfaces unless material and BSP both already disable dynamic lights; require explicit Quake3e OpenGL renderer for publication

findings: The original imported-grid winding disagreed with normals; corrected before visible-face qualification. Earlier core-only 146/496 counts remain historical.
Native compiler surfaces can share index subsequences; unmodified owners retain their slots and reduced surfaces allocate from unreferenced contiguous storage.

A renderer option before the geometry mode exposed inherited front-only dispatch falling through to BSP compilation. The geometry mode now resolves anywhere in remaining arguments; native tests exercise that order.
Shader grammar rejects NUL inside comments, renderer-truncated tokens, non-ASCII tokens with signed-char-dependent parsing and image names exceeding runtime capacity.
Original Quake III specialized iterators may ignore nodlight. Their renderer contract remains unsupported.
Linux area_factors skipped because the queried GPU backend was unavailable; renderer tests used software Mesa llvmpipe, not GPU performance measurement.
Successive Windows fixture builds also changed native surface/index ordering. The renderer matrix was repeated against exact final artifacts; no full BSP compiler determinism is claimed.
limits: Only horizontal constant-normal/color world surfaces with exact globally affine UVs, supported opaque materials and authored nomarks/nodlight.
Only Quake3e OpenGL/IBSP46; no arbitrary shader remapping, other native formats, hardware/renderer universality or bit-identical raster guarantee.
Synthetic qualification does not measure frame time, compiler speed or memory improvement; vertex storage and file size are retained.
Source/job order can differ across compiler platforms; worker-count parity is checked within each build, not full cross-platform BSP byte identity.

Existing complete-winding VIS merge baseline omissions, raw sidecar writers, intermittent Windows process delays, conservative recursive clipping and inherited compiler warnings remain outside this task.
The broad suites exposed the dispatch regression; the subsequent targeted runs pass after repair. The record does not relabel the earlier failed suites as passing.
